presentation.description: Disappear in a flash of fey magic and leave the enemies beside your old position feeling the cut of your departure. Your action point turns bring a rush of accuracy, while fallen cursed enemies eventually offer an unpredictable choice of favors beyond your usual Misty Step. Between moving a creature into a fallen foe's place and twisting enemies into attacking their own companions, you make the battlefield feel treacherous to everyone caught in your wake.
presentation.title: Feytouched

presentation.description: Trust a distant star to guide your fear and radiant magic toward devastating critical hits, with action point strikes leaving a lingering radiant wound. Its gifts can carry you unseen through the air or turn a cursed enemy's death into an ally's sudden attack, but those favors exact their payment in pain. When the need is greatest, you and your companions can offer healing surges for a chance to reclaim spent powers, gambling on how much the star will return.
presentation.title: Student of Caiphon

presentation.description: Hold enemies in a fascination they struggle to shake, making nearby foes especially vulnerable to lingering charms and other effects. Your enchantments draw victims out of position, turn a missed attack against you into a dazed hesitation, and eventually grow more accurate and forgiving when an encounter charm fails entirely. At the height of your influence, a crowd must choose between surrendering its actions and enduring a punishing psychic torment.
presentation.title: Entrancing Mystic

presentation.description: Let your curse reach past the nearest victim and settle on the enemy you actually want to torment. As your hexes deepen, curse damage can tug foes out of position, while an action point leaves everyone already cursed struggling to strike true. Your spells spread that influence across a crowd, answer distant attackers with a fresh curse, and make gathering beside one chosen victim an invitation to share its misfortune.

Action point attacks pull cursed enemies out of position, your encounter spells eventually gain rattling, and Shadow Walk can hide you completely from those you have cursed. Your most personal terrors leave a victim dazed and vulnerable to follow-up blows, or give it a relentless illusory pursuer that strikes when its attacks fail.

presentation.description: Carry winter into the fight, adding cold to a chosen encounter spell and resisting the chill yourself. Your action point attacks drive that cold through resistance, while later teleports leave nearby enemies hurting and slowed in the place you abandoned. By exposing a foe to deeper cold, reclaiming a spent cold spell, and laying a creeping frost that can progress into a stun, you make each escape feel further away.
